rows.behavior: voice memo upload: who may record, caps, size, format and length limits, refusals

claims.claim: A person with three memos waiting is refused (429)
Ten minutes of waiting audio in the org refuses a memo (503)
Who may record and the caps are checked before the body is read
A third check at once in the api is refused (503), unread
Over 5 MB is 413 and is read no further
A format not named by its first bytes is 415
A declared type that does not fit the bytes is 415
Only Opus, AAC, PCM, MP3 or Vorbis audio is allowed (415)
Over 3 minutes by decoding is 422
ffmpeg reads the memo from a temporary file with no name on disk
A picked contact is logged with the memo, at once
Deleting a lead deletes its waiting audio
Audio rows are deleted at commit; Postgres's log and backups keep the bytes until they turn over

rows.behavior: the memo page: record, send a file, badge, Transcribing, failed line, polling

claims.claim: The recorder stops itself at 2:59.5
It records in the first of WebM, MP4 or Ogg the browser supports
A known extension sets the type sent for a picked file
Without a microphone API the page offers only the file
A redraw while the browser asks for the microphone drops the memo unsent
A Voice badge shows on a voice note
A waiting memo says Transcribing…
A memo that cannot be transcribed says Couldn't transcribe this memo. Record it again.
A memo with no model key says it needs one
The lead page does not redraw while a memo is recorded or sent
The lead page polls while a note is transcribing, pending or needs a model
The poll interval is 15 seconds

rows.behavior: transcriber process: separate job kind, startup checks, model download, expiry, failure and deletion

claims.claim: The transcriber is started as firstcall worker --kind transcribe
The main worker never claims transcribe jobs
The transcriber claims transcribe jobs only
It checks ffmpeg and ffprobe before claiming any job
It imports faster-whisper before claiming any job
It loads the model, downloading if needed, before claiming any job
A failed startup check exits 1 and says which
The scheduler fails a memo waiting 30 minutes after upload
The expiry runs in the scheduler, so it happens with no transcriber
Any failure sets failed/not_transcribed and deletes the audio
A failed memo keeps a picked contact (only the note's read state changes)
Transcription runs in a process of its own, with no key
int8 on the CPU
2 threads
language en
beam 5
voice activity filter on
no conditioning on earlier text
The product defaults to small.en until the eval runs

rows.behavior: voice gold, scorer and corpus command, ADR-005 candidates and scoring rule

claims.claim: Ten voices read the seed-11 scripts
Names are scored by sound from a fixed table of spelling groups
42 of seed 11's 150 scripts hold a name in the spelling table (counted against evals/gold/notes/seed-11/scripts.jsonl)
WER lower-cases, drops punctuation and reads numbers with the note scorer's reader
The strict spelling count is reported on its own line

rows.behavior: ffmpeg requirement, voice profile, voice image and the voice dependency group

claims.claim: ffmpeg is needed for the voice tests
ffmpeg is needed by an api outside Docker (it runs ffprobe and ffmpeg on every upload)
The voice profile adds the transcriber to compose
The voice group is installed with uv sync --group voice
Plain uv sync leaves the voice group out (it is not a default group)
The transcriber starts with firstcall worker --kind transcribe
The transcriber runs on 2 CPUs
The transcriber has 1.5 GB
The model downloads into the whisper-models volume
The default size is small.en
The small.en model file is about 480 MB (483,545,366 bytes, measured in the local Hugging Face cache)
